<script>

async function insertVerity(leadData) {
const headers = new Headers();
headers.append("Content-Type", "application/x-www-form-urlencoded");

const formData = new URLSearchParams();
for (const key in leadData) {
    formData.append(key, leadData[key]);
}


let urlParams = new URLSearchParams(window.location.search);
let queryParams = Object.fromEntries(urlParams);
for (const key in queryParams) {
    formData.append(key, queryParams[key]);
}


let fragment = window.location.hash.substring(1);
let fragments = fragment.split("&");
fragments.forEach((value, key) => {
    queryParam = value.split("=");
    formData.append(queryParam[0], queryParam[1]);
});

const requestOptions = {
    method: "POST",
    headers: headers,
    body: formData
};

fetch(verityLeadpostUrl, requestOptions)
.then(response => response.json())
.then(data => {
    console.log("Respuesta de la API:", data);
})
.catch(error => {
    console.error("Error al enviar la solicitud:", error);
});
}

async function sendContactEmail() {

};

console.log("email sended");

const response = await fetch(contactEmailUrl, requestOptions);

return response;
}

function GenerateRandom() {
return (((1 + Math.random()) * 0x10000) | 0).toString(16).substring(1);
}

function validateEmail(email) {
const res = /^[\w-\.]+@([\w-]+\.)+[\w-]{2,4}$/;
return res.test(String(email).toLowerCase());
}

<script>
    // Función para obtener los parámetros UTM de la URL
    function getLeadSource() {
        const urlParams = new URLSearchParams(window.location.search);
        return {
            utm_source: urlParams.get('utm_source') || '', // Evita valores nulos
            utm_medium: urlParams.get('utm_medium') || '',
        };
    }

    // Obtener UTM y determinar la fuente del lead
    let utmParamsLead = getLeadSource();
    let lSource = utmParamsLead.utm_source.trim();

     // Asignar valores personalizados según el origen
    if (lSource.toLowerCase() === 'qrcode') {
        lSource = 'QR Code';
    } else if (lSource.toLowerCase() === 'bussinescard') {
        lSource = 'Bussines Card';
    } else if (lSource !== '') {
        lSource = 'Google Ads';
    } else {
        lSource = 'Bunji SEO';
    }

    console.log("Lead Source:", lSource);

    // Solo guardar si no existe ya el usuario
    if (!sessionStorage.getItem("usuario")) {
        const usuario = {
            leadSourceMemory: lSource,
        };
        sessionStorage.setItem("usuario", JSON.stringify(usuario));
    }
</script>

<script>
document.addEventListener("DOMContentLoaded", function () {
  const input = document.querySelector("#form-field-phone");

  if (!input) return;

  /*
   * Bloquea escritura manual de indicativos distintos a +1
   * Ejemplo bloqueado: +57, +52, +34, +44
   */
  input.addEventListener("input", function () {
    const value = input.value.trim();

    if (value.startsWith("+") && !value.startsWith("+1")) {
      input.value = "+1";
    }
  });

  /*
   * Bloquea pegado de indicativos distintos a +1
   */
  input.addEventListener("paste", function (event) {
    const pastedText = (event.clipboardData || window.clipboardData)
      .getData("text")
      .trim();

    if (pastedText.startsWith("+") && !pastedText.startsWith("+1")) {
      event.preventDefault();
      input.value = "+1";
      alert("Only US phone numbers starting with +1 are allowed.");
    }
  });

});
</script>
